Sanofi’s non-binding $52.50 proposal was received on April 15, 2016, publicly announced on April 28, and rejected on April 29. Pfizer approached in April and entered a confidentiality and standstill agreement on June 29, while Medivation announced several confidentiality agreements, including Sanofi’s, on July 5. Pfizer submitted a non-binding $65.00 cash proposal on August 8 with satisfactory diligence remaining, no financing condition and approximately one week expected for diligence and signing. Medivation admitted Pfizer and several unnamed parties to a subsequent stage on August 10, and Pfizer submitted a requested merger-agreement markup on August 18 and a $77.00 cash proposal on August 19. Following a best-and-final request, Pfizer offered $81.50 cash on August 20, signed that afternoon and announced the transaction with Medivation on August 22. The supplied chronology focuses on Pfizer, leaves unnamed counts and identities unresolved, and reports no other stage bids, so cohort exits follow the ledger conventions.
